abilities.name: Sacrifice
abilities.note: Sacrifice: heavy damage on one player, heal them hard.

tricks.title: Enslave a satyr
tricks.text: A warlock can enslave one of the nearby satyrs and send it at him.

tactics.general: Teleports a player to his altar for Sacrifice, that player needs big heals. Intense Pain is a dispellable area effect, ranged stay at max range.
tactics.healer: Big heals on the Sacrifice target.

abilities.timing: when its target is 0-10 yards away, every 14-25s

tactics.general: Either burn him and ignore the Hydrolings, or AoE the Hydrolings first. They hurt more than he does, watch health and interrupt.

abilities.name: Enervate
abilities.timing: when its target is 0-40 yards away, every 11-16s

tactics.general: Shapeshifts, let the tank regain threat after each shift. Satyr form: remove Enervate (mana drain) and Wither (disease), interrupt. Tree form: big armor, use spells. Wolf form: like a cat druid. At 35% the wall breaks and non-elite adds rush out, AoE them.

tactics.general: Summons eyes around the room, one ranged kills them. Enrages at 50%. Teleports random players to the middle, if it's the tank, wait for threat.
Clear all the ancients nearby or they join. Trample knocks down melee, ranged stay back. Entangle can be dispelled.

abilities.name: Arcane Blast
abilities.note: Arcane Blast, knockback and threat reset.
abilities.timing: when its target is in melee range, every 15-19s

tactics.general: Hits hard and fast. Tank him in a corner. Arcane Blast knocks back and resets his threat: stop damage until the tank has him again.
tactics.dps: Stop after Arcane Blast until the tank regains threat.

abilities.timing: when its target is 0-40 yards away, every 3-5s

tactics.general: Summons four imps on pull, AoE them once the tank has him. Interrupt his fire spells. Spirit of Runn Tum makes him bigger, faster, and reflect half of spells.

Warlock epic mount quest only. Survive the 6 minute ritual at Immol'thar's altar while the warlock keeps the three items active (imps and Dread Guards; banish or enslave the guards). Then summon the Dreadsteed; at half health Lord Hel'nurath appears. Kill him before the horse.
